title: Illumi Breaks Killua Before the Hunter Exam Does

cuts.voiceover_text: Killua finally says what he wants from life. He is tired of killing. He wants Gon as a real friend. For one second, he looks certain of it. Illumi never changes expression. He tells Killua that an assassin does not know friendship. He says Killua was raised to measure people by one question. Can he kill them? Then he turns Gon into the threat. Illumi says Gon is too bright for Killua to understand. Stay beside him long enough, he warns, and Killua will want to test himself against his own friend. Killua tries to stand firm. His fist knots at his side. But Illumi's unblinking stare starts to break that certainty.

Later, Illumi turns that warning into a test. He towers over Killua and holds one hand above him. Move, he says, and their fight begins. Even touching him is enough. Then Illumi makes the stakes cruel. If Killua refuses to fight, Gon will die. The other examinees tense behind him. They shout for Killua to strike back. Killua cannot move. He already knows he cannot defeat his older brother. Illumi keeps closing in. He reminds Killua of the lesson drilled into him since childhood. Never face someone stronger. With Gon supposedly in danger, Killua still cannot fight. At last, he admits defeat. That is when Illumi reveals the trick. He was never going to kill Gon. The threat was only a test. Illumi places a hand on Killua's head and says he has proved exactly what the family expects. Killua cannot protect a friend.

After Illumi leaves, something in Killua goes quiet. His hand curls into a fist. Then he steps into the next match opposite Bodoro with no expression at all. Bodoro raises his fists and moves first. Killua does not flinch. His eyes sink into shadow. In one sudden blur, he launches forward and sends the older fighter crashing down. When the room looks back, Bodoro is on the floor. Killua stands apart with blood on his hand and across his shirt. The other examinees freeze. Killua walks through the doors alone. The committee disqualifies him for killing Bodoro.
